example.hanzi: 我的手機壞了，不能打電話。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī huài le, bù néng dǎ diànhuà.
example.gloss: My phone is broken; I can't make calls.

vocab.gloss: one side; either side; on the one hand

example.hanzi: 他一邊走路一邊聽音樂。
example.pinyin: Tā yìbiān zǒulù yìbiān tīng yīnyuè.
example.gloss: He listens to music while walking.

example.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié hěn piàoliang, yě bú guì.
example.gloss: These shoes are pretty, and not expensive either.

example.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng xíguàn zǎo qǐ le.
example.gloss: I've already gotten used to getting up early.

vocab.gloss: (intransitive) to change; to vary; change; variation

example.pinyin: Táiběi de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà.

example.gloss: I forgot to bring my EasyCard.

grammar.title: 一邊……一邊…… (doing two things at once)
grammar.pattern: Subject + 一邊 + V1 + 一邊 + V2
grammar.explanation: Use 一邊……一邊…… to say that someone does two actions at the same time. Each 一邊 goes right before a verb phrase. In Taiwan it is usually read yìbiān. It is only for two actions done by the same person at the same time.

examples.hanzi: 她一邊吃早餐一邊看新聞。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chī zǎocān yìbiān kàn xīnwén.
examples.gloss: She watches the news while eating breakfast.

examples.hanzi: 我們一邊喝茶一邊說話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān hē chá yìbiān shuōhuà.

examples.hanzi: 別一邊騎腳踏車一邊看手機。
examples.pinyin: Bié yìbiān qí jiǎotàchē yìbiān kàn shǒujī.
examples.gloss: Don't look at your phone while riding a bike.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我一邊跑一邊看手機，走一走就壞了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yìbiān pǎo yìbiān kàn shǒujī, zǒu yi zǒu jiù huài le.
dialogue.gloss: I was running and looking at my phone, and after a while they broke.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 那我們去那家店看看新鞋吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǒmen qù nà jiā diàn kànkan xīn xié ba.
dialogue.gloss: Then let's go to that shop and look at new shoes.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 好啊，我習慣穿黑色的鞋。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒ xíguàn chuān hēisè de xié.
dialogue.gloss: OK, I'm used to wearing black shoes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 這雙怎麼樣？顏色很好看，也不貴。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shuāng zěnmeyàng? Yánsè hěn hǎokàn, yě bú guì.
dialogue.gloss: How about this pair? The color looks nice and it's not expensive.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不錯！可是我差點忘記帶錢了。
dialogue.pinyin: Búcuò! Kěshì wǒ chàdiǎn wàngjì dài qián le.
dialogue.gloss: Not bad! But I almost forgot to bring money.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wàngjì nǐ de míngzì le.
Zhè shuāng xié tài xiǎo le.
Tā yìbiān xǐ yīfú yìbiān chànggē.
Wǒ hái bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
sentences.gloss: I'm still not used to the weather here.

vocab.gloss: to plan; to intend; to calculate

example.hanzi: 我這個週末打算去看電影。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zhè ge zhōumò dǎsuàn qù kàn diànyǐng.
example.gloss: I plan to go see a movie this weekend.

example.hanzi: 這家店的牛肉麵好吃極了。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de niúròumiàn hǎochī jí le.
example.gloss: The beef noodles at this shop are extremely tasty.

vocab.gloss: to be careful; to take care

example.hanzi: 外面在下雨，騎腳踏車要小心一點。
example.pinyin: Wàimiàn zài xià yǔ, qí jiǎotàchē yào xiǎoxīn yìdiǎn.
example.gloss: It's raining outside; be a bit careful riding your bike.

example.hanzi: 學校下個月要舉行籃球賽。
example.pinyin: Xuéxiào xià ge yuè yào jǔxíng lánqiúsài.
example.gloss: The school is holding a basketball game next month.

example.pinyin: Wǒ zuì ài de dòngwù shì mǎ.
example.gloss: My favorite animal is the horse.

vocab.gloss: to be hungry; hungry; to starve (sb)

example.pinyin: Wǒ è le, wǒmen qù chīfàn ba.

grammar.title: 用「打算」說你的計畫
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 打算 + 動詞短語
grammar.explanation: 「打算」放在動詞前面，表示心裡已經想好要做的事，像英文的 plan to / intend to。問人家的計畫可以說「你打算……？」，否定用「不打算」。

examples.hanzi: 我打算這個週末去看球賽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn zhè ge zhōumò qù kàn qiúsài.
examples.gloss: I plan to go watch the ball game this weekend.

examples.hanzi: 學校打算下週六舉行籃球賽。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào dǎsuàn xià zhōuliù jǔxíng lánqiúsài.
examples.gloss: The school plans to hold a basketball game next Saturday.

examples.hanzi: 我餓了，打算先去買個便當。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ è le, dǎsuàn xiān qù mǎi ge biàndāng.
examples.gloss: I'm hungry, so I plan to go buy a lunch box first.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 你這個週末打算做什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhè ge zhōumò dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
dialogue.gloss: What do you plan to do this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 我打算跟弟弟去看動物，你要一起來嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn gēn dìdi qù kàn dòngwù, nǐ yào yìqǐ lái ma?
dialogue.gloss: I plan to go see the animals with my little brother. Want to come along?

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 學校那天要舉行籃球賽，我看完就過去找你們。
dialogue.pinyin: Xuéxiào nà tiān yào jǔxíng lánqiúsài, wǒ kàn wán jiù guòqù zhǎo nǐmen.
dialogue.gloss: The school is holding a basketball game that day; I'll come find you after I watch it.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 好啊！你現在餓不餓？我餓極了。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiànzài è bu è? Wǒ è jí le.
dialogue.gloss: Great! Are you hungry now? I'm starving.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 我也是，我們先去買便當吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě shì, wǒmen xiān qù mǎi biàndāng ba.
dialogue.gloss: Me too. Let's go buy lunch boxes first.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 好，外面在下雨，騎車小心一點。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wàimiàn zài xià yǔ, qí chē xiǎoxīn yìdiǎn.
dialogue.gloss: OK. It's raining outside, so ride carefully.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn míngtiān qù kàn dòngwù.
sentences.gloss: I plan to go see animals tomorrow.
You should be careful riding a bike.
The school is holding a basketball game tomorrow.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài hǎochī jí le.
sentences.gloss: The food at this restaurant is extremely delicious.

vocab.gloss: tree; to cultivate; to set up

example.pinyin: Xuéxiào qiánmiàn yǒu hěn duō shù.
example.gloss: There are many trees in front of the school.

example.gloss: His Chinese level is very high.

vocab.gloss: to lend; to borrow; by means of

example.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ jiè wǒ yì bǎ sǎn ma?
example.gloss: Can you lend me an umbrella?

vocab.gloss: east; host (i.e. sitting on east side of guest); landlord

example.gloss: The post office is on the east side of the school.

example.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de tóufǎ hěn cháng.
example.gloss: My younger sister's hair is very long.

vocab.gloss: to be afraid; to be scared

example.gloss: My younger brother gets scared at night.

grammar.title: 跟⋯⋯借⋯⋯ (borrow something from someone)
grammar.pattern: A + 跟 + 人 + 借 + 東西
grammar.explanation: In Taiwan Mandarin, 借 can mean both "borrow" and "lend". To say you borrow something FROM someone, use 跟 + person + 借 + thing. To say you lend something TO someone, say 借 + person + thing (我借你錢).

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué jiè le yì běn shū.
examples.gloss: I borrowed a book from my classmate.

examples.hanzi: 你可以跟我借錢,不用害怕。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gēn wǒ jiè qián, búyòng hàipà.
examples.gloss: You can borrow money from me, don't be afraid.

examples.hanzi: 他跟哥哥借了一輛腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēn gēge jiè le yí liàng jiǎotàchē.
examples.gloss: He borrowed a bike from his older brother.

dialogue.speaker: 小雨
dialogue.hanzi: 你可以借我腳踏車嗎?我要去車站。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ jiè wǒ jiǎotàchē ma? Wǒ yào qù chēzhàn.
dialogue.gloss: Can you lend me your bike? I want to go to the station.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 可以啊,不過車站在東邊,有一點遠喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ a, búguò chēzhàn zài dōngbiān, yǒu yìdiǎn yuǎn ō.
dialogue.gloss: Sure, but the station is on the east side, it's a bit far.

dialogue.speaker: 小雨
dialogue.hanzi: 沒關係,我騎車的水平很好!
dialogue.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒ qí chē de shuǐpíng hěn hǎo!
dialogue.gloss: It's fine, my bike-riding level is pretty good!

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 那條路旁邊有很多樹,晚上很黑。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà tiáo lù pángbiān yǒu hěn duō shù, wǎnshàng hěn hēi.
dialogue.gloss: There are lots of trees beside that road, it's dark at night.

dialogue.speaker: 小雨
dialogue.hanzi: 我不害怕啦!我八點就回來。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ bú hàipà la! Wǒ bā diǎn jiù huílái.
dialogue.gloss: I'm not scared! I'll be back at eight.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 好,騎慢一點喔,風大,你的頭髮會亂。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, qí màn yìdiǎn ō, fēng dà, nǐ de tóufǎ huì luàn.
dialogue.gloss: OK, ride slowly; the wind is strong, your hair will get messy.

sentences.gloss: I borrow a bike from my friend.

sentences.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng hěn gāo.
sentences.gloss: His Chinese level is very high.
The post office is on the east side of the station.

sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào lǐ yǒu hěn duō shù.
sentences.gloss: There are many trees in the school.
My little brother is very afraid of big dogs.
